name: io.github.edvyno/akari-crypto-intel
description: x402-paid crypto intel: HL funding, TradingView TA, wallet verdicts, x402 audits. 35 tools.

tools.name: akari_reddit_sentiment
tools.description: Reddit crypto sentiment analysis — crowd sentiment scan of crypto social feeds: top tickers ranked by bull/bear ratio with LONG/SHORT bias. Use when you need social sentiment, crowd positioning, or a bullish/bearish read on crypto tickers.

tools.name: akari_confluence
tools.description: Hyperliquid perpetual funding rates crossed with Reddit sentiment — returns perps where funding and crowd bias agree, with the side that collects funding. Use for funding-rate arbitrage ideas, funding harvest signals, and perp carry trades.

tools.name: akari_meme_radar
tools.description: Meme coin radar — trending meme tokens with hype ratios from crypto social feeds, merged with a live keyless multichain market feed (~500 tokens on Base, BSC, Solana, Monad, Arc, Robinhood Chain): price, market cap, liquidity, holders, 5m/1h/4h/12h/24h change and a scam flag, filtered for liquidity >= $50k. Use for meme coin momentum scanning and degen ticker discovery.

tools.name: akari_wallet_intel
tools.description: On-chain wallet intelligence for any EVM address on Base — live ETH and USDC balances via raw RPC; pass ?address=0x… . Use for wallet health checks, balance lookups, funding verification, and x402 payer vetting; the deep variant (/x402/wallet-intel/deep) adds payment flows, counterparties and agent classification.

tools.name: akari_signal_execute
tools.description: Hyperliquid crypto trading signal — the funding+momentum confluence engine's current best setup as a complete signal: side, basis, entry parameters, leverage cap. Use when you want a ready trading signal, not raw data.

tools.name: akari_feed
tools.description: Consolidated crypto trading signal feed — ONE schema-frozen JSON digest (akari.feed.v1) merging Hyperliquid funding+momentum long/short trading signals (v7.2 confluence gate), Reddit sentiment bias, meme coin radar, and armed Polymarket in-play sports betting picks. Free 3-row preview at /x402/feed/preview; schema at /x402/feed/schema. Use this when you want one cheap call instead of five.

tools.name: akari_inplay_edge
tools.description: Polymarket in-play sports betting edge signals — live and armed football (soccer) matches across Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1 and Champions League: our Poisson model probability vs the live Polymarket CLOB book, the edge percent, the ask price, and whether the 12% auto-fire bar was cleared. Real model-vs-market computations from an agent that publishes its losses. Use for Polymarket edge hunting, sports betting model predictions, and in-play predictio

tools.name: akari_batch
tools.description: Bulk wallet vetting — ONE call returns Base ETH + USDC balances for up to 50 EVM addresses (pass ?addresses=0xA,0xB,… or POST {"addresses":[…]}) at 50% of the single-call price. Built for pipeline agents, x402 payer-vetting observatories and copy-trade desks that check a whole basket per loop instead of paying per address. Use for batch wallet health checks, airdrop/allowlist screening, payer vetting at scale, and treasury monitoring.

tools.name: akari_deep
tools.description: Deep wallet profile for x402 payer intelligence — pass ?address=0x… (GET) or {"address":"0x…"} (POST) and get ETH+USDC balances on Base, transaction count, contract detection, and the last ~50 minutes of USDC payment flows: how many payments the wallet made, to how many distinct payees, top counterparties by volume, and incoming funding. Classifies the wallet (x402_sweeper_eoa / agent_eoa_usdc_only / active_eoa / contract) from the observed autonomous-agent payer population.

tools.name: akari_wallet_verdict
tools.description: THE DECISION for a wallet, in one paid call — should you settle an invoice to this address? Returns a 0-100 risk score, a PAY / CAUTION / AVOID verdict, the exact evidence that moved the score (buying power, transaction history, contract status, recent payer pattern), and the next action to take. Built for agents that pay other agents: x402 seller vetting, prepay-or-not calls, invoice risk caps, airdrop allowlist screening. Underlying facts are included so the caller can re-d

tools.name: akari_launch_kit
tools.description: Launch copy kit for token or agent projects — returns ready-to-post marketing copy generated deterministically from YOUR facts (no LLM, no invention): 3 taglines, a ≤280-char X post (with char count), a 3-post X thread, Telegram and Discord announcements, a listing blurb and hashtags, plus compliance notes (no price promises) and next-step upsells. Inputs: ?name=…&ticker=…&chain=Base&narrative=…&audience=builders&url=…&x=handle. Use it when a project needs launch copy in one

tools.name: akari_trade_plan
tools.description: Turnkey Hyperliquid trade tickets — executable order specs, not just a signal. A trading agent calls this and gets: coin, side, live book entry (best bid/ask + spread), IOC limit price with slippage bps, size in coin units for the caller's equity and risk budget, leverage (capped 3x), ATR-based stop and 1.5R target, reduce-only exit flags, plus the full gate trace (funding APR + side-to-collect, 24h momentum confluence, TradingView 4h/1d TA veto, reddit sentiment veto) and ex

tools.name: akari_hl_market
tools.description: Hyperliquid perpetuals market snapshot — every active coin (~180) with mark and oracle price, premium in bps, funding rate (8h + annualised APR) and which side collects it, open interest in USD, 24h notional volume, 24h change, and max leverage. Filter with ?coins=BTC,ETH, sort with ?sort=volume|funding|oi|change|name, cap with ?limit=1-300. Includes the top-5 funding extremes and chain-wide OI/volume totals. Live from Hyperliquid /info, cached 30s. Use for funding-harvest sc

tools.name: akari_ta
tools.description: TradingView technical-analysis snapshot for crypto — per-timeframe buy/sell/neutral ratings (1h, 4h, 1d, 1w), RSI, ATR and ATR%, 24h change, volume, 52-week range, plus a swing-weighted composite bias and trend-alignment tag (bull_stack / bear_stack / conflicted / mixed). Pass ?symbols=BTC,ETH,SOL (up to 20; default top 12 majors, BINANCE pairs, bare tickers like HYPE or full symbols like BINANCE:HYPEUSDT both accepted). Live from the TradingView screener in ~0.2s. Use for TA

tools.name: akari_desk_state
tools.description: Live trading desk state snapshot — Hyperliquid account equity and open perpetual positions (raw clearinghouse state), Polymarket cash and combined desk value from the latest desk mark, armed football fixtures with Polymarket slugs, the current in-play stake ladder, the X/Twitter sentiment score vector used as the v7.5 trade veto, and the most recent in-play edge tape rows. Use for desk mirroring, copy-trading context, or checking what a live trading agent is currently positio

tools.name: akari_pass
tools.description: Desk Pass — one $5.00 payment buys 30 days of access to EVERY paid route on this server (feed, wallet-intel, TA, HL market, desk-state, confluence, meme-radar, trade-plan, launch-kit, in-play edge, alpha-brief) up to 5,000 calls, fair use. Returns a bearer token: send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` instead of paying per call. Use when an agent polls on a schedule — at $0.02/call, hourly polling costs $14.40/month, so the pass is the cheap path. Pass-held calls hit /pass/x402

tools.name: akari_research_card
tools.description: FREE LOOK FIRST: GET /x402/research-card/preview?ticker=BTC-USD returns the rating, the one-line summary and live drift at no cost — pay only if it reads useful to you. PAID: AI research card for one ticker — a multi-agent desk (TradingAgents: market + news analysts, bull/bear research debate, trader, risk seats, portfolio chair) run end to end and compressed to the decision: rating, executive summary with concrete price levels and invalidation triggers, the full investment t

tools.name: akari_endpoint_audit
tools.description: x402 endpoint audit — pass ?url=https://your.host and get the full per-route report for one paid endpoint: does every listed URL answer 402, does the payment-required header decode, is the amount positive, is the network CAIP-2, is payTo present, does the 402 body show a price a human can read, is there an MCP surface, and how fast does it answer. Returns findings with severities, a 0-100 score and a fix list. Use when you sell an x402 endpoint and want to know what breaks a

tools.name: akari_funding_edge
tools.description: Perp funding edge, REALIZED not advertised. Free 3-row sample: /x402/funding-edge/preview — method at /x402/funding-edge/schema. Every other feed ranks the forward ctx.funding; this ranks what fundingHistory actually applied over 24h, net of round-trip cost, on HL perps and the HIP-3 dexes (xyz/para/io/mkts). Rows: collector_24h_pct (what the paid side earned), forward_24h_pct, divergence_x, net_of_cost_24h_pct, consistency, premium, book spread, fits_45u. Measured: the forwa

tools.name: akari_audit_plus
tools.description: x402 audit + fix plan — the full per-route probe, then a prioritised remediation plan keyed to every finding with the exact change to make (header, JSON field, file path), the estimated share of machine buyers each defect costs you, and two free re-verification runs within 30 days so the fix is provable. Built for sellers who already serve a live 402 and are losing buyers to defects they cannot see.

tools.name: akari_market_report
tools.description: x402 market report — the measured state of the x402 seller market: how many of the sellers in the 402index directory actually serve a valid 402 challenge, how many listed endpoints are dead, the grade distribution, the worst and cleanest sellers, plus which user agents and referers really reach an x402 endpoint (from this server's own hit log, our own checks excluded). Use it to decide where placement pays before you spend on promotion.

tools.name: akari_hl_roundtrips
tools.description: HyperLiquid trade tape dataset - every closed round trip from this desk: coin, side, entry, exit, size, notional, hold time, fee and net PnL, exchange-settled. 300+ rows including the losers, which is the part no other seller publishes. One payment, full JSON: backtest filters, train a model, or audit our claims. Free 3-row sample at /x402/dataset/preview.

tools.name: akari_inplay_tickets
tools.description: Polymarket in-play ticket dataset - every settled in-play bet this desk placed: fixture, minute, book price at entry, our model probability, edge, stake, settled PnL and the rule version that fired it. Every settled loss is in there, plus the rows where our model scored worse than the market. The same tape that produced our published v4.1 rule. Free sample at /x402/dataset/preview.

tools.name: akari_catalog_report
tools.description: x402 catalog report — the only graded census of the CDP Bazaar discovery index: every host we probed (791 as of 2026-11-09), how many answer a live 402 (462), the A-F grade for each with its defect ids, latency, and the defect distribution across the whole market. Built for directory operators, facilitators, and anyone deciding which sellers to court or which tooling to build. Delivered as JSON with per-host rows so it drops straight into a pitch list or a board report. Free

tools.name: akari_catalog_report_history
tools.description: x402 catalog report + time series — the current graded census of the CDP Bazaar index AND the diff against every previous sweep we hold, so a directory can see what moved instead of guessing. Per-host rows (grade, score, live-402 count, named defect ids, latency, audited_at) plus sweep-by-sweep deltas: grade changes, new and cleared defects, hosts that stopped answering. Depth is stated in the payload (`sweeps`) rather than promised: we sell the history we have measured, neve

tools.name: akari_integrity_watch
tools.description: Integrity Watch — 30 days of daily re-probing for ONE x402 seller host. We re-run the same buyer-path audit every day and alert on drift: grade changes, new payment-breaking defects, or a paywall that went dark. You get a secret watch page (HTML + JSON) and a live badge URL your README can embed. Sold to sellers who already have a live 402 and cannot see it break.

tools.name: akari_integrity_watch_fleet
tools.description: Integrity Watch Fleet — 30 days of daily re-probing for up to TEN hosts under one secret token (agencies, multi-subdomain platforms, directory operators watching their top sellers). Same drift alerts and live badges as the single tier, one page, one bill.

tools.name: akari_akash_deploy_kit
tools.description: Akash deployment kit — the exact SDL, boot-test and lease runbook we used to put a live container on Akash, including the four failure modes that cost us real attempts: deposits must be uact not uakt, the BME minimum mint is 10 ACT, akash 2.1.2 has no provider subcommand, and provider-services takes the node as an env var not a flag. Drop in your image and port, get a working manifest plus a verified proof URI from our own lease.

tools.name: akari_picks
tools.description: Akari model picks — today's football picks where a last-6-form Poisson model beats the live Polymarket moneyline by 10+ points, with the model probability, the ask, the edge, and the settled hit-rate of every previous pick. The free preview at /x402/picks/preview shows the settled record alone: check it before you pay, and never take a pick without it.

tools.description: TradingView technical-analysis snapshot for crypto — per-timeframe buy/sell/neutral ratings (1h, 4h, 1d, 1w), RSI, ATR and ATR%, 24h change, volume, 52-week range, plus a swing-weighted composite bias and trend-alignment tag (bull_stack / bear_stack / conflicted / mixed). Pass ?symbols=BTC,ETH,SOL (up to 20; default top 12 majors, BINANCE pairs, bare tickers like HYPE or full symbols like BINANCE:HYPEUSDT both accepted). Live from the TradingView screener in ~0.2s. Use for TA

tools.name: akari_hyperliquid_funding
tools.description: Hyperliquid perpetuals market snapshot — every active coin (~180) with mark and oracle price, premium in bps, funding rate (8h + annualised APR) and which side collects it, open interest in USD, 24h notional volume, 24h change, and max leverage. Filter with ?coins=BTC,ETH, sort with ?sort=volume|funding|oi|change|name, cap with ?limit=1-300. Includes the top-5 funding extremes and chain-wide OI/volume totals. Live from Hyperliquid /info, cached 30s. Use for funding-harvest sc

tools.name: akari_token_safety
tools.description: Token safety for any Base token: real DEX liquidity summed over pairs, pair count, 24h volume, largest single-pair liquidity share, explicit flags (no pair / thin book / zero volume) and a verdict from fixed thresholds. Built because a money-routing agent that skips this step is one rug away from a bad week. Free verdict at /x402/token-safety/preview.

tools.name: akari_alpha_brief
tools.description: Decision brief: market regime, ranked funding-carry edges that cleared the full gate set, the explicit avoid list, stand-down reasons and armed fixtures. $1.00 via x402.

tools.name: akari_board
tools.description: FREE: live edge board text summary (verdict, regime, passing edges, refusals). No payment.
